title: LXC 111: implement the scaffold-engine capability (reach the engine's own AI surface)
description:
On LXC 111, add a backend route that proxies to scaffold-engine's own surface so the operator can test/use larger local models on the Tesla P40 (24GB), with the engine's address read from config (operator-supplied value). No UI yet. On container 111.

[Engine split of ADD100 — 4 of 8] Done when the capability WORKS, not when its code exists (operator decision 2026-10-07): the panel's engine route, called on 127.0.0.1:3001 inside CT 111, returns scaffold-engine's own /health answer with `"status":"healthy"`.
